Class MountTable

java.lang.Object
oshi.driver.common.unix.bsd.disk.MountTable
@ThreadSafe public final class MountTable extends Object
Parses the BSD mount tables and df -i into the fields a file store needs.

Each format is parsed by its fixed parts rather than split on whitespace, so a mount point containing spaces keeps them. None of these commands escapes a space: each prints the kernel's path as it is.

  • Method Details

    • parseFreeBsdLibxo

      public static List<MountTable.Entry> parseFreeBsdLibxo(List<String> json)
      Parses FreeBSD's mount -p --libxo json.

      mount -p pads its fields with tabs, but after a field of 24 characters or more it separates it from the next with a single space, which a space inside the field cannot be told apart from. The JSON form carries the same fields unambiguously.

      Parameters:
      json - the lines of mount -p --libxo json
      Returns:
      the mounted file systems, or an empty list where mount does not support libxo

    • parseFstab

      public static List<MountTable.Entry> parseFstab(List<String> lines)
      Parses mount -p on DragonFly, or on a FreeBSD whose mount has no libxo.

      DragonFly prints device<TAB>mount point<TAB>type options<TAB>dump pass, one tab between each, so a mount point keeps its spaces. FreeBSD pads every field with tabs instead, which leaves the type and options apart, except that a field of 24 characters or more is followed by a single space: a long mount point then shares its field with the type, which is split off at the last space. Any other line is split on whitespace, which cannot keep a space in a mount point.

      Parameters:
      lines - the lines of mount -p
      Returns:
      the mounted file systems

    • parseOpenBsdVerbose

      public static List<MountTable.Entry> parseOpenBsdVerbose(List<String> lines)
      Parses OpenBSD's mount -v. A file system on a disk is followed by its DUID and partition in parentheses, which becomes the identifier without them; one with no disk, such as tmpfs or NFS, has none.
      Parameters:
      lines - the lines of mount -v
      Returns:
      the mounted file systems

    • parseDfInodes

      public static Pair<Map<String,Long>, Map<String,Long>> parseDfInodes(List<String> df)
      Parses df -i output into free and total inode counts keyed by mount point. The layout is the same on FreeBSD, DragonFly, NetBSD and OpenBSD.

      The mount point is the key because it is unique where the volume is not: two tmpfs mounts both name tmpfs as their volume.

      Parameters:
      df - the lines of df -i
      Returns:
      a pair of the free and the total inodes, each keyed by mount point
